exploration.working_classification: high-risk constructive hypothesis; not formal research selection
exploration.central_mechanism: use full-Fock CAR exchange-pair sum as zero relation and difference as nonzero two-body signal, then ask for a shared real-control path realizing different second/third-order exchange assignments
exploration.algebraic_facts_used: known CAR identities, one-body gl(m) commutator, PBW comparison, elementary formal parity/composition identities; hand reasoning only, no operator tables computed
exploration.unresolved_core: lift the exchange relation to a physically admissible Hermitian control path respecting shuffle/Lie constraints, without reducing to completed loops or generic DCG
exploration.comparison_test_not_sufficient_by_itself: nonzero generic third-order residual mapping to CAR zero could be faked by appending a CAR-null identity cell; require CAR essential inside the target-producing joint cell
exploration.primitive_changes: hypothetical additional Hermitian orbital hopping/phase and n_p factors coupled to same bus X/P; no free non-Hermitian E exponential or two-body force; no fixed future pulse count, box or numerical input
exploration.target_scope: initial four-distinct-orbital Hermitian double-excitation component; not full chemical Hamiltonian coverage or general complex-phase guarantee
exploration.D1_D2: no block-encoding/qubitization migration; keep original scalar, one-body and remaining interaction terms and absolute E0 target
exploration.full_Fock_sector_boundary: exchange identity holds on full Fock; N=1 alone loses the two-body signal; no sector-only/global no-go inference
exploration.minimum_next_check: paper-level four-orbital exchange-cell real-path lift with nonzero second-order signal, full third-order cancellation and explicit known-method reduction test; not started
exploration.next_responsibility: GPT/user decide whether and within which access scope to commission the minimal paper check; Codex stops after publication
